capabilities: filter file explorer entries by frontmatter metadata
match values with equals, contains, exists, includes, greater and less operators
combine multiple filters with AND or OR logic
hide matching files or show only matching files
create filters from the file right-click menu
extras: README notes the plugin was developed with aider; lists planned features including filter presets and import/export of filter configurations.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows all files and cannot filter visibility by frontmatter metadata values.
summary: Explorer filter plugin that hides or shows files in the file explorer based on frontmatter metadata rules with multiple operators.
